items.body_raw: רִדְפוּ אַחֲרָיו
items.answer_raw: Pursue after him.

items.body_raw: אָמַרְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶיךָ
items.answer_raw: I have promised to keep thy words.

items.body_raw: בָּא יוֹסֵף מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִקְבֹּר אֶת־יַעֲקֹב
items.answer_raw: Joseph came from the land of Egypt to bury Jacob.

items.body_raw: יָרְדוּ בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב מִצְרַיְמָה לִשְׁבָּר־אֹכֶל
items.answer_raw: The sons of Jacob went down to Egypt to buy food.

items.body_raw: וְעַתָּה קְבֹץ אֵלַי אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וְאֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחַן אִיזָבֶל
items.answer_raw: And now gather to me all Israel to mount Carmel and the prophets of the Ba'al four hundred, that eat at Jezebel's table.

items.body_raw: I promised (said) to pursue after them.
items.answer_raw: אָמַרְתִּי לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵיהֶם

items.body_raw: Pursue after him.
items.answer_raw: רְדֹף (or רִדְפוּ) אַחֲרָיו

items.body_raw: He set the stars in the firmament of the heavens to rule over the night.
items.answer_raw: נָתַן אֶת־הַכּוֹכָבִים בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם לִמְשֹׁל בַּלָּיְלָה

items.body_raw: Keep thy tongue from evil.
items.answer_raw: שְׁמֹר לְשׁוֹנְךָ מֵרָע

items.body_raw: They left off counting the proverbs of his lips, for they (were) as the sand which (is) upon the shore of the sea.
items.answer_raw: חָדְלוּ לִסְפֹּר אֶת־מִשְׁלֵי שְׂפָתָיו כִּי הֵם כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם

items.body_raw: He came to shed blood.
items.answer_raw: בָּא לִשְׁפֹּךְ דָּם

items.body_raw: Bury my corpse in the grave where the prophets (are) buried (ptc.).
items.answer_raw: קְבֹר (or קִבְרוּ) אֶת־נִבְלָתִי בַּקֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר הַנְּבִיאִים קְבוּרִים שָׁם

items.body_raw: יִקְרָא הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּסֵפֶר הַתּוֹרָה כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּיו לְמַעַן יִלְמַד לְיִרְאָה אֶת־יהוה אֱלֹהָיו
items.answer_raw: The king shall read in the book of the law all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God.

items.body_raw: אֶשְׁמְרָה תוֹרָתְךָ תָמִיד
items.answer_raw: I would keep thy law continually.

items.body_raw: נִכְרְתָה בְרִית אֲנִי וְאַתָּה וְהָיָה לְעֵד בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ
items.answer_raw: Let us make a covenant, I and thou, and it shall be for a witness between me and thee.

items.body_raw: אַל־תִּקְצֹף יהוה עַד־מְאֹד
items.answer_raw: Be not very angry, O Yahweh.

items.body_raw: אָמַר יַעֲקֹב אֶל־עֵשָׂו מִכְרָה כַיּוֹם אֶת־בְּכֹרָתְךָ לִי וַיִּמְכֹּר לוֹ אֶת־בְּכֹרָתוֹ
items.answer_raw: Jacob said to Esau, First sell me thy birthright; and he sold him his birthright.

items.body_raw: Let me lie down.
items.answer_raw: אֶשְׁכְּבָה

items.body_raw: May Yahweh judge between me and (between) this people.
items.answer_raw: יִשְׁפֹּט יְהוָה בֵּינִי וּבֵין הָעָם הַזֶּה

items.body_raw: Hear my prayer (O) our God.
items.answer_raw: שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי אֱלֹהֵינוּ (or שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי (emphatic imperative))

items.body_raw: וְעַתָּה יוֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלַםִ וְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה שִׁפְטוּ־נָא בֵּינִי וּבֵין כַּרְמִי
items.answer_raw: And now, ye inhabitants of Jerusalem and ye men of Judah, judge, I pray you, between me and my vineyard.

items.body_raw: Before he cut off all flesh by the waters of the flood
items.answer_raw: לִפְנֵי כָרְתוֹ כָּל־בָּשָׂר מִמֵּי הַמַּבּוּל

items.body_raw: נְפֹל
items.answer_raw: Fall (sing. m.); might also be inf. cstr.

items.body_raw: לִנְפֹּל
items.answer_raw: To fall

items.body_raw: מַה־טּוֹב לָכֶם הַמְשֹׁל בָּכֶם שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ אִם־מְשֹׁל בָּכֶם אִישׁ אֶחָד
items.answer_raw: Which is better for you—(is it) that seventy men rule over you or that one man rule over you?
